verdict.rationale: Evidence shows gstack skills are plain files hosted on GitHub (SKILL.md files, install via git clone/symlink) so a lead could technically inspect files on disk or via raw URLs, but there is no documented CLI command or workflow for listing skill contents before install or reading all files after install as a review feature. missing for 10: a documented 'list contents before install' command, a documented 'read every file after install' review workflow, and any first-party or community confirmation of such a review UX.
